return: Earliest timestamp at which all n people are connected through the accumulated undirected friendship edges, or -1 if no such time exists. Edges with equal timestamps occur at the same time; their internal processing order cannot change the timestamp result.

numeric: Timestamp sort differences are exact integers in [-1000000000, 1000000000].
